newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London continue Tokyo sell off.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London continue Tokyo sell off.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London remained under pressure on Monday after taking a steep tumble in Tokyo, dealers said.
The Nikkei Index of top 50 shares in London fell 32.22 points, or 2.38 percent, to 1,320.96, after the Nikkei 225 finished down 3.37 percent in Tokyo.
"Everywhere you look people are bearish," one trader said, adding that investors might take advantage of today's falls to buy on Tuesday but he thought the trend was still downward.
"People said it would hold at 18,000 and it didn't. Now 14,000 is the next support level, and then 12,000."
